title: Decoupling High and Low Frequencies for Faithful Image Generation with Fine Details
abstract: arXiv:2509.05441v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Latent generative models compress images into learned embeddings prior to synthesis, and the generation quality critically depends on how faithfully these embeddings preserve visual detail. We observe that while such embeddings are effective at reconstructing low frequency structure, they struggle to recover sharp high frequency details that are essential for perceptual realism. Conventional reconstruction objectives implicitly prioritize coarse structural information over high frequency content, which can lead to overly smoothed outputs and degraded visual quality in textured regions. Motivated by this observation, we propose DeBaT, a Decoupled frequency Band Tokenizer that explicitly separates the learning of low and high frequency band embeddings. translated_title: 解耦高低频以实现忠实且细节丰富的图像生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.05441v4 公告类型：交叉替换  摘要：潜在生成模型在合成前将图像压缩为学习嵌入，生成质量关键取决于这些嵌入如何忠实地保留视觉细节。我们观察到，虽然这类嵌入在重建低频结构方面有效，但难以恢复对感知真实性至关重要的锐利高频细节。传统重建目标隐式地优先考虑粗略结构信息而非高频内容，这可能导致过度平滑的输出和纹理区域视觉质量下降。基于此观察，我们提出DeBaT，一种解耦频带分词器，明确分离低频和高频频带嵌入的学习。这种解耦能够准确重建细节，同时保持全局一致性。集成到基于潜在扩散的生成模型中，DeBaT允许生成锐利图像。
tldr: DeBaT通过显式解耦高低频嵌入，解决了潜在生成模型中高频细节丢失问题，从而在保持全局连贯性的同时实现锐利细节的忠实图像生成。
en_tdlr: DeBaT explicitly decouples high and low-frequency embeddings to address detail loss in latent generative models, enabling sharp and faithful image generation while preserving global coherence.
